name: faster-whisper
description: Faster-whisper(https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper) is a reimplementation of OpenAI's Whisper model using CTranslate2, which is a fast inference engine for Transformer models. This container provides a Wyoming protocol server for faster-whisper.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Local path for Whisper config files.

variables.name: DEBUG
variables.description: If set to `true`, or any other value, the container will output debug logs.

variables.name: LOCAL_ONLY
variables.description: If set to `true`, or any other value, the container will not attempt to download models from HuggingFace and will only use locally-provided models.

variables.name: WHISPER_BEAM
variables.description: Number of candidates to consider simultaneously during transcription.

variables.name: WHISPER_LANG
variables.description: Two character code for the language that you will speak to the add-on.

variables.name: WHISPER_MODEL
variables.description: Whisper model that will be used for transcription. From here(https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper/blob/master/faster_whisper/utils.py#L11-L31).
